name: Sedma Dominoes
description: Connecting domino game named after the Czech word for seven. Four players receive seven tiles each; no boneyard. Lead rotates; the leader must set a double. Players in turn extend the train from one side only or pass. Points for setting doubles; game to 60.

content.text: Connecting domino game named after the Czech word for seven. Four players receive seven tiles each; no boneyard. Lead rotates; the leader must set a double. Players in turn extend the train from one side only or pass. Points for setting doubles; game to 60.
Sedma (Czech for seven) is a connecting domino game; the layout is built in one direction only and extra points are scored for playing doubles. Related in name to the Czech card game Sedma.
Four players use a double-six domino set; each receives seven tiles. There is no boneyard; play is individual with no partnerships.
Each player receives seven tiles. There is no boneyard.
